channel.title: IndieHOT — Indie Game Hot Topics
channel.description: IndieHOT collects indie game news from a set of public sources every day and scores it by rules: engines & tools, publishing & marketing, devlogs, industry & funding, events, reviews & postmortems. Only titles, one-line self-written summaries and outbound links are shown — no full text is republished.

item.title: Flutter Flame Tutorial: Build Your First 2D Game (Beginner Guide)
item.description: If you already know Flutter, you're closer to shipping your first game than you think — this beginner guide walks you through building a 2D game with the Flame engine.

item.title: Mastering Steamworks: A Technical Guide for Indie Publishing
item.description: A hands-on technical guide that breaks down the Steamworks APIs and tools to help indie developers get publishing, player experience and discoverability right.

item.title: Colossal Order's CEO on data, gut feeling and why "a game for everyone is a game for no one"
item.description: Colossal Order's CEO reflects on how the studio picks games that keep finding their audience: her first answer was gut feeling, until she looked closer at what really guided those choices.

item.title: Learn How To Create This Colorful Cel Shader in Blender 5.3
item.description: Using Blender 5.3's new Light Accumulation node, the author walks through the full workflow for building a colorful cel shader.

item.title: Finding Minecraft Slime Chunks in Python and JavaScript (Reproducing Java's Random)
item.description: Slime chunks come down to a small formula built on java.util.Random — the author reproduces it in Python and JavaScript and explains how seed tools work under the hood.

item.title: Shipping Demo V7.1: Fixing i18n Localization Routing & Syncing Audio/Subtitles in Flashback Memories
item.description: The sci-fi action-RPG V.E.T.O.R — A Ruptura ships Demo V7.1, fixing i18n routing and syncing audio with subtitles in its flashback memories.

item.title: Godot HUD tutorial 2D: hearts, a stamina bar that holds a grudge, and icons that gray out when locked
item.description: A step-by-step Godot 2D HUD tutorial: hearts driven by HP, a stamina bar with a lingering 'ghost' drain, and skill icons that gray out and count down during cooldown.

item.title: Roblox signs licensing deal with PRS for Music
item.description: Roblox has struck a licensing deal with UK music rights organisation PRS for Music, opening a new revenue stream for songwriters and composers whose work is used on the platform.

item.title: 60 FPS Particle Explosions in 10 Lines of Vanilla JS (+ AI Prompts)
item.description: You don't need a third-party physics engine for juicy explosions — this tutorial shows how raw HTML5 Canvas and a few array tricks deliver smooth 60 FPS particle effects in ten lines of JavaScript, with AI prompts included.

item.title: NSP-BOX Switch Static Recompiler PC v2.8.4: Vulkan & AVX2 Architecture Guide
item.description: This Switch static recompiler for PC updates to v2.8.4, with notes on its ahead-of-time ARM64-to-x86_64 translation pipeline and Vulkan shader caching.

item.title: This Tool Brings 2D Painting Workflows Into Unreal Engine 5
item.description: Inky recreates traditional painting materials inside Unreal Engine 5, letting artists paint 3D assets with a 2D workflow.

item.title: Is your data telling you the whole story?
item.description: Fragmented data hides the full player picture — this post explains what it costs UA and monetization teams and how to connect MMP, GA and IAP signals to Unity Vector.

item.title: Sensor Tower introduces web store revenue estimates
item.description: Sensor Tower now estimates direct-to-consumer web store revenue, giving developers a fuller picture of app and game monetisation beyond the stores.

item.title: Solitaire with 3D card physics in Rust and WebGL 2, no game engine
item.description: 23 browser card and board games written in about 12,400 lines of Rust, compiled to a single 1.16 MB Wasm file with 3D card physics — no game engine, no physics engine.

item.title: Building a Zero-Dependency Branching Interactive Fiction Engine in 90 Lines of ESM
item.description: A hands-on tutorial building a branching interactive-fiction state machine — conditional choices, relationship meters and a memory ledger — in just 90 lines of dependency-free ESM, with a complete MIT-licensed example project.

item.title: Building a Game-Based Learning Module for UK Schools: A Pre-Production Checklist
item.description: A learning game for UK schools succeeds or fails on decisions made before anyone opens an engine, and this pre-production checklist helps small teams sort out lesson length, shared devices, curriculum fit and data compliance first.

item.title: I built a local Gaussian splat to game-mesh converter, and sold it as a one-off instead of a subscription
item.description: The author turns Gaussian splat scans into game-ready meshes with textures, a collider and two LODs, and shares why they sold the local tool as a one-off instead of a subscription.

item.title: A Practical Workflow for Designing Sound Effects from Text Prompts
item.description: Start with a clear text description, generate, listen, then refine the prompt — this piece lays out a practical workflow for designing game sound effects from text prompts, handy for devs prototyping audio fast.

item.title: Russia Considers Mandatory Game Licensing and Letting Security Services Access Player Data
item.description: Russia is weighing mandatory publishing licenses for games along with monitoring requirements that would give security services access to player data — a compliance signal worth watching for developers publishing abroad.

item.title: Sony's delight: 40% of PS5 players flocked to GTA 6, 39 million entered the city, and 70% of new console owners played it first
item.description: Sony shared early platform figures for GTA 6: 40% of PS5 players jumped in, 39 million entered the city, and 70% of new console owners made it their first game.
